study: Cost-aware warehouse sensing and handover admission
design_after: The frontier slow-hardware stress test showed 14-16% command loss; those sites are discovery only
gate_rule: Compare 30-second expected MCS0 retry-failure area at the current AP with four seconds of certain outage plus candidate failure area after the outage; reject planned moves with nonpositive gain. Keep the existing reactive fallback.
failure_probability: Fixed ns-3/Nakagami/blockage surrogate used by the frontier loss; not a calibrated end-to-end risk guarantee
selection: Choose scan cadence and gate per method by lowest total development control misses, then highest bulk throughput, then stable option order
latency: Use frozen cadence-specific measured service budgets plus 500 ms; same FIFO and scan accounting as the frontier
primary: Selected distilled configuration versus independently selected RadioMap configuration on four new sites
secondary: Compare each selected configuration with its one-second/rescue default on the same fresh sites
